The Users overview displays the trend line for total users (active and inactive) and their activity on the Now Platform.
Total Users
It displays the trend line of the total users on the Now Platform.
Total users
Active Users
It displays the trend line of active users on the Now Platform.
Active users
Inactive Users
It displays the trend line of inactive users on the Now Platform.
Inactive users
Successful Logins
It displays the trend line of your users' successful logins on the Now Platform.
Successful logins
Failed Logins
It displays the trend line of your users' failed logins on the Now Platform.
Failed logins
External Logins
It displays the trend line of users' using external logins on the Now Platform.
External logins
Users Never Logged In
It displays the trend line of users who have never logged in on the Now Platform.
Users never logged in
Users Not Logged In Last Month
It displays the trend line of users who have never logged in on the Now Platform since the last month.
Users not logged in since the last month
Users Not Logged In Last Year
It displays the trend line of users who have never logged in on the Now Platform since the last year.
Users not logged in since the last 1 year
Not Locked Out Inactive User
It displays the trend line about not locked out inactive users on the Now Platform.
Inactive users who are not locked out
New Users
It displays the trend line for new users added to the Now Platform.
New users
Users not logged in since the last 6 months
It displays the trend line of users who have never logged in on the Now Platform for the last six months.
Users not logged in since the last 6 months
Users Need Password Reset
It displays the trend line about the users who have to reset their password to log in to the Now Platform.
Need to reset password
User Password Reset Failures
It displays the trend line about the password reset failures of the users on the Now Platform.
Password reset failures of the users
Local logins not protected by MFA
It displays the trend line of users using local logins without MFA enforcement on the Now Platform.
Local logins not protected by MFA
